newsitem.title: CANADA: FULL TEXT-Bid for Placer Pacific, Highlands.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Bid for Placer Pacific, Highlands.

text.p: VANCOUVER, Nov 27 - The following is full text of an announcement by Placer Dome Inc.

Placer Dome Inc announces it is launching takeover bids for the 24.6 percent publicly owned interest in its subsidiary Placer Pacific Limited as well as for all of the shares of Highlands Gold Limited, a Papua New Guinea company which owns 25 percent of the Porgera Joint Venture.
The value of these transactions upon completion will be about US$600 million.

"This is about growth for Placer Dome shareholders and a golden opportunity for the shareholders of Highlands Gold and minority shareholders of Placer Pacific," John Willson, President and Chief Executive Officer, said.
"We have great confidence in the Asia Pacific region. Placer Dome is consolidating its presence to compete more effectively."

The bid for Highlands Gold is a cash offer of A$0.75 per share. The offer will be conditional upon no material change to the business or operations of Highlands Gold, the Australian Stock Exchange Gold Index not falling below 1500 during the offer period, and the Bank of Papua New Guinea approving Papua New Guinea residents' acceptance of the offer.
There will be no minimum acceptance condition.

With on-market purchases made yesterday at A$0.75 per share, Placer Dome already holds 33 percent of Highlands Gold. Placer Dome is making an offer at the same price to all shareholders under the Papua New Guinea Companies Act.
"The offer represents a premium of over 36 percent on the Highlands Gold share price on Tuesday, November 26, the date immediately before yesterday's purchases," Mr Willson said.
"It is cash, it has no minimum acceptance condition and I believe that Highlands Gold shareholders will recognize the attractiveness of the offer," he said.
Placer Dome also announces it is offering one Placer Dome common share for every 15 Placer Pacific shares.

The bid is conditional upon Placer Dome gaining sufficient acceptances to exercise compulsory acquisition rights under the Australian Corporations Law, there being no material adverse change to the business or operations of Placer Pacific, the Australian Stock Exchange Gold Index not falling below 1500 during the currency of the offer, and Foreign Investment Review Board approval.
At Placer Dome's closing price in New York on November 26, the offer values Placer Pacific at A$2.03 per share.
The Placer Pacific offer is not being registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933 and no shares will be issued to persons resident in the United States.
"We are offering Placer Pacific shareholders the opportunity to participate directly in Placer Dome's global growth," Mr Willson said.

"As well as a significant premium of almost 50 percent over the Placer Pacific price on November 26, Placer Pacific shareholders will participate in a high-growth company with a portfolio of mines in Australia, the Pacific, and the Americas. We hope that they will remain long-term shareholders of Placer Dome."
Placer Dome intends to deliver takeover documents to Highlands Gold shortly, and expects to send the offer documents to Highlands Gold shareholders in mid-December.

The Placer Pacific takeover documents will take longer to complete because it is a share offer, and will be delivered to the company at the end of December. The offer documents will be forwarded to Placer Pacific shareholders in mid-January 1997.
The Placer Pacific offer will be extended to shares issued under the Placer Pacific Executive Option Scheme during the offer period.
